name: Content Management / PIM
description: Why this matters: Centralizing content and product data shortens time-to-publish, lowers error rates, and keeps every channel consistent. Platforms that centralize product data, digital assets, and content, enabling omnichannel delivery, governance, and a single source of truth across websites, apps, and commerce. Preferred defaults: Pimcore for data-heavy catalogs; Sanity for bespoke editorial workflows; Hygraph for GraphQL-first federation.
